verdict.rationale: The README's install instructions explicitly offer both scopes: copy the skill folder into the personal (all-projects) skills directory or the project skills directory. This is a single manual-copy line, and the scoping itself comes from the host agent's skills directories rather than from a scope option in the skill. Missing for 10: an explicit note that project-local installs can be committed with the repo, scope selection in the plugin/marketplace install path, exact directory paths, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose install scope — project-local files committed with my repo, or user-global across all projects

citations.quote: Copy the skill folder into your personal (all projects) or project skills directory
